ITEM.PTXT: 225/45R17 tires adopted on Version S of 2AZ-FE engine models. Exclusive suspension tuning has been performed, achieving a high level of both excellent handling stability and ride comfort.
The damping force characteristics of the shock absorbers and the spring rate characteristics of the coil springs have been optimized.
Vehicle height has been optimized by changing the installed load characteristics.

The coil spring is separate from the shock absorber and is mounted lower, and a pigtail coil shape is used to reduce size and weight, accommodating the low floor package. In addition, spring insulators are provided at both the upper and lower ends of the spring, and their thickness is optimized to provide excellent vibration isolation and ride comfort.
The bound stopper is made of urethane to optimize the stopper characteristics.

Low-pressure gas (N2) sealed type shock absorbers are used to achieve stable damping force characteristics, achieving a high level of both steering stability and ride comfort. For details, refer to the shock absorber section of the front suspension.
The V-shaped design avoids the side members, achieving a low floor while ensuring wheel stroke.
Outer-tube bonded type bushings are used for mounting to the suspension member.
A ball bushing is used for mounting to the axle, ensuring high support rigidity.
A lower arm consisting of a combination of an arm with a toe adjustment mechanism (lower arm No.1) and a pressed steel plate arm (lower arm No.2), and a pressed steel plate trailing arm are used.
For mounting the lower arms to the axle, lower arm No.1 uses a ball joint and lower arm No.2 uses a ball bushing, ensuring high support rigidity.
An outer-tube bonded type bushing is used for the front bushing of the trailing arm, ensuring longitudinal compliance for excellent ride comfort.
A solid type is used. The stabilizer bar is mounted to lower arm No.2 via ball joint type stabilizer links.
Rubber bushings are used at the suspension member side mounting points.
A parallel cross frame made of hollow pipes and pressed steel plates is used.
High rigidity is provided at the mounting points of each suspension arm, ensuring excellent steering stability.
